description:
The Angular Universal project is configured to use the source folder **src/app** as its application directory, with the root component identified by the selector **app-root**. The associated client-side application is named **my-angular-client**, and the server‑side entry point is the file **main.server.ts**. The root server module class is **AppServerModule**, defined in **app.server.module.ts**.

For the Express engine, the server script is **server.ts**, which will listen on port **4000**. The TypeScript configuration for the server build is stored in **tsconfig.server.json**. All required packages will be installed as part of the setup (i.e., we are **not** skipping the installation step).
